Container.Name: turkushan-auth
Container.Overview: Login portal (forward auth) for *.turkushan.com behind Nginx Proxy Manager. Self-registration, per-site approval, admin panel. One container, SQLite in /data.

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: Port NPM uses to reach the portal.

Config.Name: COOKIE_DOMAIN
Config.Description: Cookie domain, shared by all subdomains (SSO).

Config.Name: ADMIN_USER
Config.Description: Admin account created on first start.

Config.Name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Admin password (min 10 chars). Only used when the admin account is created; change it in the panel afterwards.

Config.Name: TRUSTED_PROXIES
Config.Description: IPs/CIDRs of NPM. Client IP headers are only trusted from these.

Config.Name: PORTAL_INTERNAL_URL
Config.Description: How NPM reaches this container; used in the generated nginx snippets.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User the app runs as (99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group the app runs as (100 = users).

Config.Name: SESSION_SECRET
Config.Description: Optional (min 32 chars). Leave empty to auto-generate one in /data/secret.
